scope: Bounded local-series CPU pilot with four development source families and four disjoint reserved confirmation source families. Series and horizons remain nested observations, not independent source replications.

protocol.split_index_rule: train_end=floor(3*n/5), validation_end=floor(4*n/5), test_end=n; all ends exclusive
protocol.selection_rule: SHA256(salt + NUL + source_id + NUL + series_id), lexicographically ascending among train-prefix-eligible series, shared across regimes/budgets. Keep all if fewer than four eligible.
protocol.eligibility_rule: Require >=16 finite complete training windows in each adopted regime and a positive finite train-prefix difference MSE scale; inspect training prefix only. Do not replace a selected series because validation/test windows are missing.
protocol.window_cap_rule: Evenly spaced indices among finite chronological origins, including endpoints if cap>=2; availability-only filtering precedes cap; cap1 takes last origin.
protocol.target_rule: Targets are origin+1 through origin+H inclusive, represented [origin+1,origin+1+H); entire target must lie in its split. Context uses only observations through origin.
protocol.missing_rule: Retain upstream missing markers as NaN; exclude windows with any unavailable context/target; no imputation. Record all candidate/available/selected counts.
protocol.preprocessing: None in data loader; each candidate fits its own learned preprocessing using training data only.
protocol.scale_rule: MSE denominator computed on the entire uncapped training prefix: finite seasonal differences with >=2 pairs and positive MSE; otherwise finite first differences with >=2 pairs and positive MSE; else exclude using training data only.
protocol.seasonal_period_policy: Fixed frequency map monthly12,weekly52,daily7; a benchmark convention, not a model-selected estimate. A model requiring unavailable seasonal lag must use its declared fallback.
protocol.local_model_rule: One model per series and regime; no pooled cross-series fitting and no assumed shared calendar across Tourism series.
protocol.pre_outcome_feasibility_decision: At 60% training, Hospital length84 gives50 training observations and0 complete windows for L48,H6; Traffic length104 gives62 training observations and3 windows for L52,H8. Before any model outcomes, monthly contexts were reduced to12/24 and weekly to13/26, giving Hospital21 and Traffic29 potential long-regime training windows. Daily28/56 unchanged. The minimum16 training-window rule applies to every selected series/regime.
protocol.confirmation_policy: Confirmation family membership fixed from metadata; no comparative model evaluation or forecast losses used in source selection. Confirmation should be evaluated once after development freezes choices.
